title: T2AG optional first-run profile
description: All five user-facing profile items are optional. t2ag_init.py applies the documented public defaults when an item is omitted. Language is selected during installation and does not enter answers.json.

example_only.description: Example refusal marker; the tool must not consume a payload when this is true.

nickname.description: How the learner wants to be addressed.

learning_level.description: Learning level: secondary-school student, university student, or bachelor.

reference_curriculum.description: Whether to introduce a reference curriculum; an unanswered item remains to be generated.

tutoring_preference.default: map first, then one branch at a time; confirm after each step
tutoring_preference.description: Advanced optional override; do not ask during first run.

small_adjustment.default: at most one runtime adjustment per cycle

big_adjustment.default: one adjustment window every three cycles

exercise_hint_gate.description: The exercise hint gate defaults to enabled and can be changed later.

learning_timezone.description: Advanced optional override; IANA timezone name.

updated.description: Advanced optional override; defaults to the host's current date.

x-not-in-this-schema.teaching_language: Set by the no-default installation language choice: zh-CN for Chinese, en-US for English. Init preserves the edition template value.
